title: undercurrent
summary: Exhibition identity for undercurrent, the Fall 2026 first-year MFA show at Yale School of Art.
credits:
Exhibition Identity: Junyeol Baek, [Lee Richardson](https://www.instagram.com/leerichardsonnz/)
Client: Yale School of Art
Location: Green Hall Gallery, Yale School of Art
description:
The identity speaks in the language of karaoke: the show's details appear as lyrics on screen, filling with colour word by word — come on in, come on in, to the first-year MFA show.

Green Hall Gallery, Yale School of Art, 14 November – 6 December 2026.
